evidence: Modifies `src/net_processing.cpp` to extract message handling routines out of `PeerManagerImpl::ProcessMessage()`.
rationale: Extracting message-handling logic into dedicated private methods improves navigation and encapsulation within `net_processing.cpp`. As noted in the description, `PeerManagerImpl::ProcessMessage()` is an oversized monolithic function; splitting it into move-only per-message helpers is a worthwhile internal cleanup, though it does not fix a bug or retire an active protocol hazard.
